content:
Maria G.: grabbing handoff now — primary for next 8h. quick summary: INC-2026-451 is active, high p99 latencies on embeddings-serving in eu-west, customer-facing errors for a small subset of enterprise tenants. details below and actions in progress.

incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered INC-2026-451 at 1769504200 — severity: P1 — symptom: embeddings pipeline p99 > 8s, error 503s observed. linked alert: https://alerts.internal/redwood/INC-2026-451

Aditya K.: thanks Maria. I'm currently on the bridge, running warmfix attempt #2 (rolling restart of embedding-workers pool in eu-west-primary). first attempt reduced error rate but p99 stayed elevated. cause hypothesis: KV cache thrash + cold GPUs on a subset of nodes.

Maria G.: who is primary/secondary for the region now?

Sam P.: primary=Maria G., secondary=Aditya K. — Leo is on call for infra if we need host-level changes.

Leo T.: infra standby. I looked at host metrics — one rack (rack-7) shows intermittent GPU memory pressure + OOMs on model-server-agent. I've cordoned two hosts for investigation.

Maria G.: customer impact: 3 enterprise customers (acct ids redacted) reported timeouts in the last 30m — support already opened cases. not a platform-wide outage but high impact for those tenants. current mitigation goals: restore stable p99 < 1s for all healthy capacity groups and failover affected tenants to fallback-models in Dedicated if necessary.

Aditya K.: mitigations in progress:
- rolling restart of embedding-workers (eu-west-primary) ongoing, batch-size temporarily lowered to 8 to reduce memory pressure.
- KV cache eviction thresholds increased on the fly for the embedding route (see below).
- enabling fallback routing to quantized-variant for affected tenant shards if restart doesn't stabilize within 20m.

Maria G.: commands I'm running now:
```
# reduce batch size for embedding route
redwoodctl routes update embeddings-eu --batch-size=8 --timeout-ms=2000
# increase cache eviction aggressiveness
redwoodctl cache set embeddings-eu --eviction-factor=1.25
```

Sam P.: logging/observability notes: logs show model-server-agent restarts around 1769502000 and 1769503800 on host gpu-7-14. stack traces point to CUDA OOM during kv-cache growth. charts: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/eu/embed-p99

infra-bot: Note: cordoned hosts gpu-7-14 and gpu-7-15. Auto-replace disabled for now (manual investigation).

Leo T.: I'm SSH'ing into gpu-7-14 now. running `dmesg` and checking nvidia-smi memory timeline. if we confirm hardware flakiness we'll swap to spare rack.

Aditya K.: status update (10m): rolling restart is 60% complete, errors dropped from 4.2% -> 1.1% for restarted subset, overall p99 improved from 8.3s -> 3.6s. still above SLO. next step: enable fallback routing for the worst-affected tenant shard (tenant-shard-42) at ~1769505600 if no further improvement.

Maria G.: action items for handoff in 30m:
- If p99 > 2s after restart completes, flip fallback routing for tenant-shard-42 to quantized-variant (Aditya).
- If host OOMs continue post-restart, LV swap to spare rack-9 (Leo).
- Keep support loop updated and escalate revenue-impacting customers to SEs (Maria).
- Runbook pointers: runbook/embed-ops.md (section: OOM-induced tail latency) and playbook/fallback-routing.md.

Sam P.: runbook snippet for fallback routing:
```
# enable fallback route for a shard
redwoodctl routing set --shard tenant-shard-42 --route embeddings-eu:quantized-v2 --weight 1.0
# verify traffic shift
redwoodctl routing check --shard tenant-shard-42
```

Maria G.: current gaps/risks:
- spare capacity: limited in eu-west until rack swap completes.
- background rollout windows tomorrow morning may overlap with final remediation — coordinate with release-ops.
- observability: a dash widget for per-shard p99 was missing, added a temporary panel (link above) but it's noisy. need a proper alert to target shard-level tail latency.

Aditya K.: ETA for stabilization: 20–30m contingent on successful completion of restarts and no repeated OOMs. if we hit repeated OOMs, mitigation path is fallback -> rack swap -> potential customer failover to Dedicated.

Maria G.: handoff plan (to whoever takes next):
- primary remains whoever is on-call at next shift start; secondary stays for 1h overlap.
- if you take over, confirm: p99 chart, error rate, host OOMs, and whether fallback route was applied.
- contact points: @Aditya K. (model), @Leo T. (infra), support-oncall (case triage).

Aditya K.: added temporary notes in incident doc: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-451 — include logs from restarted nodes and the routing changes.

Maria G.: ok I'm going to tag for escalation if we don't hit p99 < 2s by 1769506200. leaving bridge for the next 30m then will handoff to @Aditya K. as acting primary if still active.

Sam P.: acknowledged. I'll ping release-ops about avoiding any morning rollouts until this closes. :white_check_mark:

Leo T.: update: gpu-7-14 shows consistent OOM traces, I'm isolating and pulling diagnostics; will report before handoff.

Maria G.: thanks all — handoff note posted. next update by 1769506020 or earlier on any change. :lock:
